geometryEvidence.summary: Published outside diameter with a reconstructed annular PCB and component arrangement.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Source-dimension reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD. Only the outside diameter and LED count are published for this ring; height, inner diameter and component stack are authored assumptions. Hole centres, hole sizes, LED/capacitor pitch and solder-pad geometry are photo-derived approximations. Ring rear pads follow a common generic layout; exact selected-supplier routing is not verified. Check the delivered module before making a mounting plate. Wires, headers, solder joints and PCB copper routing are omitted.
